transcript.text: This morning I was helping another team investigate a load-test harness, and I confirmed that the production burst requirement for the audit-event pipeline is 40,000 events per second. The architecture document must specify required capacity as 40,000 events per second. NimbusMQ throttles at 25,000, while StreamForge supports 40,000. I haven't updated the architecture document yet because the harness investigation was a separate task.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical procurement issue. I received the latest data-processing terms from our legal review just an hour ago: EU customer audit events must be stored in the eu-west-1 region, and only StreamForge offers the required eu-west-1 residency under the shortlisted contracts. I have not yet attached these terms to the architecture review, but this data-residency requirement directly impacts the service selection.
